PROFILE SUMMARY

Associate Manager with 7+ years of experience in Reconciliation, Trade Capture, Hedge Funds, Fund Administration, and Oversight Operations. Experienced in NAV review, investor reporting, portfolio reconciliation, fund migrations, trade lifecycle management, audit support, and stakeholder management. Strong knowledge of Equities, Fixed Income, Bonds, Money Market Instruments, Derivatives, Mutual Funds, Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Collateral, and Crypto Funds, with a proven track record of process improvement, and operational excellence.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Hexaware Technologies (Lead Analyst – Private equity)

Feb 206 -June2026

Roles and Responsibilities

Led end-to-end conversion and migration of Private Equity funds to new accounting platforms. • Reviewed LPA, PPM, and legal documents to accurately configure fund structures. • Reconciled migrated data with legacy systems to ensure financial accuracy and data integrity. • Supported migration of capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest, and waterfalls. • Executed parallel testing and defect resolution for successful production deployment. • Prepared mapping files, test cases, conversion checklists, and SOP documentation. • Ensured compliance with client requirements, accounting standards, and project timelines. • Provided post-go-live support by resolving production issues and ensuring smooth transition. May 2024 – Aug 2025

Led end-to-end conversion and migration of Private Equity funds to new accounting platforms. • Reviewed LPA, PPM, and legal documents to accurately configure fund structures. • Reconciled migrated data with legacy systems to ensure financial accuracy and data integrity. • Supported migration of capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest, and waterfalls. • Executed parallel testing and defect resolution for successful production deployment. • Prepared mapping files, test cases, conversion checklists, and SOP documentation. • Ensured compliance with client requirements, accounting standards, and project timelines. • Provided post-go-live support by resolving production issues and ensuring smooth transition. May 2024 – Aug 2025

Roles and Responsibilities

To review the files of NAV pack, Trial balance, Balance sheet, Account Statement, Realized Gain loss, Capital Activity and Management Fee and clear the all types of breaks in cash/position reconciliation. • To Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly financial reporting packages for the Private Equity funds, Crypto Fund, Hedge Fund, including the determination of "Net Asset Value" and review of Investor statements

Manage daily cash reconciliations for complex accounts, ensuring discrepancies are promptly investigated and resolved.

Design workflows in Alteryx Software • Managed end-to-end fund onboarding and project setup, including processing input feeds, performing reconciliations, executing fund conversions during production parallel runs, and successfully launching funds with complete reconciliation and direct client reporting.

Designed and delivered process-specific training for new hires and existing team members, reviewed fund activities, and managed daily work allocation, leave planning, and workload balancing. • Led global fund migrations and system conversions, ensuring accurate historical data transfer and

successful onboarding onto the eFront platform.

Bank of New York Mellon (Senior Associate – Trade capture management under fund accounting)

Mar. 2020- May 2024

Roles and Responsibilities

Review client securities instructions, cancellations, and amendments for funds in an accurately and

timely manner within the NAV deadlines.

Worked as part of the Trade Processing team within Fund Accounting, handling trade capture, bulk uploads, pre-upload validation, trade matching and settlement across securities, FX, Futures, Options and Money Market instruments, while resolving trade exceptions within NAV deadlines.

Process Global Security transactions on the Global trade processing platforms within TAT. • Interact with both internal and external stake holders to resolve trade related issues. • Reconciling of transactions blotter and swift to confirm the accounting has processed in a timely and accurate manner thus ensuring we do not miss NAV deadlines.

Ensure all trades are matched 100% with swifts, without any discrepancy also clear all types break (security, missing trade information, pricing) and centralized trade for NAV calculations.

Ensure client positions are correct and all transactions are processed. • Exceptions out of system tolerance are cleared by taking backups from Bloomberg terminal and ICE. • Handling audit requirements and ad hoc client requirements in fund accounting • Query resolution in accordance with time frames set out in client SLAs. • Updating client SOP’s and fund recording in Webex, for new joiners’ purpose. • Reviewing the daily work in terms of risk, identify failures, missing controls, and discuss/propose solutions to solve them.

Performed bulk trade uploads and pre-upload validation for fund transactions, reviewing trade files for completeness, accuracy and required trade attributes before processing to minimize downstream exceptions and STP breaks.

Performed pre-upload validation of trade instructions and transaction data, checking security details, trade attributes, pricing and settlement information before the transactions were processed within the fund accounting workflow.

Utilized TLM for reconciliation and exception management, investigating trade, cash and position discrepancies, performing root-cause analysis and coordinating with brokers, custodians and internal stakeholders for timely resolution.

Worked with Standing Settlement Instructions (SSI) as part of the trade and settlement workflow, validating settlement-related details and coordinating corrections for incorrect or missing instructions. 6 months of hands-on SSI experience can be mentioned in the CV only if you want to show the duration.

Supported CCP/clearing-related activities for derivative transactions, with exposure to the clearing workflow and its downstream impact on trade processing, reconciliation and fund accounting.



State Street Syntel Service Trade Analyst (Transaction Services)

Aug. 2018 –Feb.2020

Roles and Responsibilities

As a part of Screening team, entrusted with the task of identification, verification and authentication of faxes received and routing of US and non- US transactions to the appropriate processing team within deadlines (validation process).

Dealing with financial instruments like equity, derivatives, short-term funds, FX, Swifts and cash relates.

Performing signature verification and perform callbacks with the clients for high-risk investment and the fund group to avoid fraudulent activities.

As a part of RRT (Research and resolution team) dealing with all problem regarding instructions and escalate it to client also Amending the trades and revising them as per client’s requirement. • Capture Derivative Trade authenticate the trade and Perform Callback sent to derivate processing

(Collateral, Future Margin Movement, Option, Swap Trade)

Review and trained to new juniors and resolved their quires, Mistakes and errors to maintain work quality.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLSET • Fund Launching • Merger project • Working on team automation • Fund Conversion, Migration

• Reconciliation, Cash & Position, Fund Accounting,

TECHNICAL SKILLSET

MS Office (outlook, Excel, word and power point) • Xceptor, Bloomberg, ICE, Invest One, Eagle, Trace, GRX, Seamless • Instruct lite, Alteryx, MCH, Swifts, MCH, Test key

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

Modern Institute of business management, Pune University MBA (Finance) 2018

M. D. Palesha College of Commerce, North Maharashtra University B.com (commerce) 2016

REWARD AND RECOGNITION

• Recipient of ‘SPOT award’ for processing high volume consistently. • Recipient of two time ‘Syntel Champ Award’ in Jan. 2019 and May 2019 • Appraised by superiors for being a quick learner of the process and performing well to

complete the allocated work before time.

Received the WOW an internal award in BNY Mellon for delivering the work Excellence and being Client focus.

Commended by clients and leadership for managing multiple fund migrations and delivering accurate cash reconciliations under tight timelines.

Recognized for new fund and awarded Kudos for consistent high performance and support.

Appreciated for leading reconciliation break-resolution (application automation), reducing breaks and manual intervention.

DECLARATION: I here-by declare that, the above information furnished by me is true, correct and complete, to the

best of my knowledge and belief.
